scenes.name: TWO MOVES
lines: Choose two moves on a board that wraps around. You may repeat a move, or go backwards.
在会绕回原处的棋盘上选两个动作，允许重复，也允许倒走。
Here, all eight positions are reachable in at most two steps. The expressions show how.
这里八个位置都能在两步内到达；每个式子给出一种走法。
But a larger board can work when a smaller one fails. At radius four, thirty-two positions can work, while twenty-eight cannot.
更大的棋盘反而可能可行：半径四时，三十二个位置可以成功，二十八个却不行。

scenes.name: COEFFICIENT DIAMOND
lines: Record the net number of each move as two integer coordinates. The cost is the sum of their absolute values.
用两个整数记录两种动作的净次数，代价是它们绝对值的和。
At radius four, the allowed coefficients form this diamond of forty-one points.
半径四允许的系数构成这个含四十一个整数点的菱形。
Different coefficients may reach the same position. Their differences form the relation lattice. Counting points alone misses this overlap.
不同系数可能到达同一位置；它们的差组成关系格子。只数点会忽略重合。

scenes.name: SUM AND DIFFERENCE
lines: Replace the coordinates by their sum and difference. The diamond becomes a square with a parity restriction.
把坐标换成和与差，菱形变成一个带奇偶限制的正方形。
The sum of absolute values equals the larger absolute value of the sum and difference.
绝对值之和，等于和与差的绝对值中较大的那个。
For the groups in this paper, a careful parity argument gives a four by four square covering twice k lattice classes. So twice k cannot exceed sixteen.
对本文的群，仔细处理奇偶性后，用四乘四正方形覆盖二倍 k 个格子类，因此二倍 k 不能超过十六。

scenes.name: THE SMALL DEFICIT
lines: Almost filling a square forces the relation lattice into a rigid shape. Its deficit is a product of two displacements.
几乎装满正方形会强制关系格子具有特定形状；亏损等于两个位移的乘积。
At radius four, k equals seven would leave deficit two. But both displacements must be even.
半径四时，若 k 等于七，亏损就是二；然而这两个位移都必须是偶数。
Their product is divisible by four, so it cannot equal two. This rules out every pair of moves on that board.
它们的乘积能被四整除，不能等于二，因此这个棋盘上的任何动作对都失败。

scenes.name: THE MATCHING CONSTRUCTION
lines: For k equal to eight, the deficit is zero, so that obstruction disappears.
当 k 等于八，亏损为零，刚才的障碍消失。
The paper gives relation vectors that actually cover the group, rather than relying on the absence of an obstruction.
论文给出真正实现覆盖的关系向量，而不只是说明障碍消失。
These two vectors give the group with thirty-two positions and covering radius four. Together, necessity and construction complete the classification.
这两个向量给出三十二个位置、覆盖半径四的群；必要性与构造合在一起完成分类。

scenes.name: ALLOW OTHER GROUPS
lines: Allowing other noncyclic abelian groups changes the maximum. Radius four now permits thirty-six positions.
允许其他非循环交换群后，最大值改变了：半径四可以达到三十六个位置。
The proof counts the sparsest coefficient residue class. The smallest prime divisor of twice the radius plus one determines the answer.
证明数出最稀少的系数余数类；半径的二倍加一的最小素因子决定答案。
Bajnok and Beatty supplied the attaining constructions. Ma and Zhang complete the upper bound and the classification explained here.
达到上界的构造来自 Bajnok 与 Beatty；Ma 与 Zhang 完成这里解释的上界与分类。
